mapper.select: select CUR_DATE from SYS_DATE where institution_code = #{institutionCode}
select CUR_DATE from SYS_DATE where institution_code = 'ALL' or institution_code in ( select institution_code from sys_institution where institution_type = '01')

select CUR_DATE, SYSTEM_CODE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, INSTITUTION_CODE from SYS_DATE
WHERE INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institutionCode}
mapper.update: update SYS_DATE set CUR_DATE=#{newDate, jdbcType=DATE} where 1=1
update SYS_DATE set CUR_DATE=#{newDate, jdbcType=DATE} WHERE INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institutionCode}

update SYS_DATE set CUR_DATE = CUR_DATE + 1
WHERE INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institutionCode}
